facebook.content:
"And I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; and whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven." - Matthew 16:19

Jesus is giving you authority to unlock breakthroughs and make decisions with confidence. Will you step into your God-given role to bind limitations and loosen the chains that have held you back? What will you bind or loose today by the power of Jesus' authority in your life?
